distribution.narrative: Cognato et al. (2024) reports the first China record from Guangxi, Shangsi, Shiwandashan, based on one UFFE specimen collected 27 March 2018.

host_note: Hosts are unknown. The paper's statement 'presumably mycetophagous' is general biology and is not promoted as a host record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Sueus granulatus (Eggers, 1936).

taxonomic_history.name: Sueus granulatus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Hyorrhynchus granulatus Eggers, 1936 was removed from synonymy with H. lewisi, restored to valid species status, and transferred to Sueus as Sueus granulatus (Eggers, 1936), stat. res., comb. nov. Both acts are retained.
